description: Regenerable cache, log, and temp paths for CAD/CAM and 3D-print tooling under $HOME on macOS: Autodesk Fusion/AutoCAD/Meshmixer, FreeCAD, OpenSCAD, Onshape desktop, SolidWorks eDrawings, Rhino/Grasshopper, SketchUp, Shapr3D, PrusaSlicer lineage (Prusa/Bambu/Orca/Super), Ultimaker Cura, ChiTuBox, Lychee Slicer, MeshLab, Blender residual extras, Open3D. path_count counts distinct path templates across rules.
never_touch_notes: User CAD project files and working dirs (.f3d offline copies intentionally kept, .dwg/.dxf, .FCStd, .scad sources, .3dm, .skp, .shapr workspaces, STEP/IGES/STL/3MF project trees under Documents/Desktop/Downloads)
Slicer user profiles and printer/filament/process presets under Application Support/*/user (only cache/log/temp subtrees listed)
Rhino plugins (MacPlugIns), Yak packages, Grasshopper user objects, FreeCAD Mod/Macro addons, SketchUp components/materials libraries as delete-enabled roots
Fusion webdeploy/production live install binaries (only stale CIP/logs/HTTP caches and offline W.Login design cache as medium/opt-in)
Autodesk Identity Services / Web Services login state (credentials; excluded)
Shapr3D sandbox Documents/workspace project copies (only tmp/Caches/Logs)
Open3D intentionally retained dataset trees if used offline (open3d_data is medium, default_enabled false)
sources: Autodesk Fusion offline cache FAQ: ~/Library/Application Support/Autodesk/Autodesk Fusion 360/<id>/W.Login
Autodesk Fusion Neutron Platform and webdeploy.streamer.log paths (support articles)
Autodesk login-cache reset paths Identity Services / Web Services (excluded from delete rules)
AutoCAD for Mac Application Support Autodesk/AutoCAD 20xx support articles
OpenSCAD manual: Application Support/OpenSCAD and backups; org.openscad.OpenSCAD
PrusaSlicer GitHub/issues: Application Support/PrusaSlicer/cache; bundle com.prusa3d.slic3r
Ultimaker Cura wiki: Application Support/cura|Cura/<ver>/cache and cura.log
CHITUBOX docs: clear cache under Application Support; dmp on macOS
McNeel Rhino Mac: Application Support/McNeel/Rhinoceros; Caches com.mcneel.*
SketchUp forum: Application Support/SketchUp 20xx; login_session (not wiped wholesale)
Shapr3D discourse: Containers tmp under com.shapr3d.*
Blender manual: Application Support/Blender/<ver>; cache/temp; residual beyond apps-creative

rules.name: Autodesk Fusion Library/Caches
rules.description: Fusion 360 NSCache and related Autodesk Fusion cache bundles under ~/Library/Caches.
rules.notes: Close Fusion first. Regenerable client HTTP/thumbnail/GPU helper caches.

rules.name: Autodesk Fusion logs
rules.description: Fusion installer/streamer and runtime logs under Library/Logs and Application Support.
rules.notes: Includes webdeploy.streamer.log style trees. Safe log wipe; leave Identity/Web Services auth files alone.

rules.name: Autodesk Fusion CIP / telemetry caches
rules.description: Customer Involvement Program and related Autodesk telemetry/temp under Application Support.
rules.notes: Telemetry/download scratch; not design documents. Avoid Identity Services and Web Services login DB/XML.

rules.name: Fusion offline design cache (W.Login)
rules.description: Locally cached Fusion cloud designs under Autodesk Fusion 360/<user-id>/W.Login. Regenerable from cloud; large re-download.
rules.notes: Official offline cache root. Prefer contents of per-user W.Login trees only in scanners that can filter; whole root is medium because it may hold more than pure cache. Close Fusion; ensure online re-sync available. Do not delete webdeploy app installs here (separate path).

rules.name: Fusion Neutron Platform temp/cache
rules.description: Neutron Platform runtime temp and non-pref caches used by Fusion.
rules.notes: Some Options XML are preferences (NGlobalOptions); treat as medium. Prefer Cache subtrees when present.

rules.name: AutoCAD for Mac caches
rules.description: AutoCAD NSCache and Autodesk AutoCAD local cache trees.
rules.notes: Leave Application Support/Autodesk/AutoCAD 20xx Support/plot styles and customizations; only Caches/Local regenerable trees.

rules.name: AutoCAD for Mac logs
rules.description: AutoCAD crash and session logs under Autodesk logs.
rules.notes: Versioned log folders; harmless to clear. Support path patterns from Autodesk Mac support-path articles.

rules.name: FreeCAD logs and cache
rules.description: FreeCAD.log and Cache directory under Application Support; optional Caches bundle IDs.
rules.notes: Do not wipe Application Support/FreeCAD/Mod, Macro, or user.cfg wholesale. FreeCAD.log itself is regenerable (file may sit next to Cache).

rules.name: FreeCAD main log file
rules.description: Primary FreeCAD.log written under Application Support/FreeCAD.
rules.notes: Target FreeCAD.log / FreeCAD.log.old style files only when scanner supports file globs; path root documented for discovery. Prefer contents filter *.log.

rules.name: OpenSCAD caches and auto-backups
rules.description: OpenSCAD Application Support backups and NSCache; geometry cache regenerates on compile.
rules.notes: User libraries often live under Documents/OpenSCAD/libraries (never-touch). backups/ holds timed editor backups of .scad; regenerable if source files kept.

rules.name: Onshape desktop / Electron caches
rules.description: Onshape desktop shell or App Store helper Chromium caches (browser primary; desktop residual).
rules.notes: Onshape is primarily cloud/browser; paths cover desktop wrappers and iOS/Mac App Store container caches only.

rules.name: SolidWorks eDrawings caches and logs
rules.description: eDrawings for Mac viewer caches/logs (not SolidWorks part libraries).
rules.notes: Viewer-only; regenerable thumbnails and HTTP caches.

rules.name: Rhino for Mac caches
rules.description: McNeel Rhinoceros NSCache and Application Support cache/temp folders (not plugins).
rules.notes: Leave MacPlugIns, packages (Yak), scripts, and settings.

rules.name: Rhino and Grasshopper logs
rules.description: Rhino for Mac and Grasshopper diagnostic logs.
rules.notes: Safe log wipe. Grasshopper definitions (.gh/.ghx) and UserObjects are not under Logs.

rules.name: Grasshopper temp and cache
rules.description: Grasshopper component temp/cache under McNeel Application Support.
rules.notes: Do not delete Libraries or UserObjects.

rules.name: SketchUp caches
rules.description: Trimble SketchUp NSCache and versioned Application Support cache/webcache trees.
rules.notes: Leave Components, Materials, Styles, Plugins. login_session.dat is auth state, not listed for bulk wipe.

rules.name: SketchUp and LayOut logs
rules.description: SketchUp/LayOut crash and diagnostic logs.

rules.name: Shapr3D caches and tmp
rules.description: Shapr3D App Store container Caches/tmp and non-sandbox Caches (not Documents workspaces).
rules.notes: Discourse users report large tmp under the Shapr container; Documents/workspace project copies are never-touch.

rules.name: PrusaSlicer vendor/index cache
rules.description: PrusaSlicer cache directory (vendor indices, locks, downloads) under Application Support.
rules.notes: Confirmed cache/ in GitHub issues (vendor_indices.zip, .lock). Leave profiles, printer configs, and filament presets in parent Application Support.

rules.name: PrusaSlicer logs
rules.description: PrusaSlicer log files under Application Support and Library/Logs.

rules.name: Ultimaker Cura cache
rules.description: Cura versioned cache (definitions cache, HTTP) under Application Support/cura.
rules.notes: Prefer */cache subdirs under version folders (e.g. cura/5.x/cache). Parent paths listed for discovery; avoid deleting user printer definitions outside cache/. Cura wiki documents cache under Application Support/cura/$VER/.

rules.name: Ultimaker Cura logs
rules.description: cura.log and related Ultimaker Cura logs.
rules.notes: cura.log often sits inside versioned Application Support/cura/<ver>/; contents filter *.log preferred.

rules.name: Bambu Studio cache
rules.description: Bambu Studio (PrusaSlicer fork) cache and NSCache.
rules.notes: Leave user/ filament and process profiles. Forum references Application Support/BambuStudio layout.

rules.name: OrcaSlicer cache and system profile cache
rules.description: OrcaSlicer cache, logs, and regenerable system profile cache.
rules.notes: Orca docs: Help > Clear Cache; system profiles rebuild. Do not wipe user/ custom presets.

rules.name: SuperSlicer cache
rules.description: SuperSlicer (PrusaSlicer fork) cache and logs.
rules.notes: Folder casing varies SuperSlicer vs Superslicer on macOS installs.

rules.name: ChiTuBox cache, dumps, logs
rules.description: CHITUBOX Basic/Pro Application Support cache, crash dumps, and logs.
rules.notes: Official FAQ: clear cache under Application Support on Mac. Prefer Cache/Log/dmp subtrees; avoid wiping user machine profiles if scanner cannot filter. Pro docs note macOS cache location can be dynamic.

rules.name: Lychee Slicer caches and logs
rules.description: Mango3D LycheeSlicer Application Support caches, Electron GPU/Code caches, and logs.
rules.notes: Mango3D reinit renames whole Application Support/LycheeSlicer; we only target cache/log/tmp Electron subdirs so login/library state survives.

rules.name: Autodesk Meshmixer caches and logs
rules.description: Legacy Meshmixer Application Support temp/cache and NSCache (discontinued but still installed).
rules.notes: Prefer Temp/cache subfolders; full Application Support/Meshmixer may hold prefs (medium if wiping wholesale).

rules.name: MeshLab caches and logs
rules.description: MeshLab / PyMeshLab NSCache and Application Support temp.
rules.notes: Regenerable viewer/filter caches only.

rules.name: Blender residual version caches (extra)
rules.description: Blender versioned cache dirs not fully covered by creative-blender rule (5.x and Foundation alternate layout) plus asset index cache.
rules.notes: Residual vs apps-creative (which used Blender Foundation/Blender/*). Manual documents user dir as Application Support/Blender/<ver>. Cache holds asset library indexes; rebuilds on browse. Leave config/, scripts/, extensions/.

rules.name: Blender temp and crash logs residual
rules.description: Blender crash logs under temp and Application Support log leftovers.
rules.notes: Temp also uses /tmp and $TMPDIR for render layers/physics; only blender-prefixed trees listed. Autosave .blend1 in project dirs never-touch.

rules.name: Open3D dataset and cache
rules.description: Open3D downloaded example datasets and library caches.
rules.notes: open3d.data.* downloads often land in ~/open3d_data. Medium: re-download cost for offline demos. Not user project meshes.

rules.name: Shared Autodesk installer leftovers logs
rules.description: Additional Autodesk shared log/temp under user Library for CAD installers.
rules.notes: Installer/ODIS logs and caches only; not licensed product data.
